scripts.text: Hm? You're... What is it about you? I've been an honorable Knight for a long time, but I cannot understand this feeling I'm getting from you...
May god bless your body and soul, warrior. I hope you will show your courage and protect those who are weaker than you.

Let the Novice fight while you take the damage.
Give the Novice a bunch of Zeny and items.
